data.name: Subhankar
data.gender_notes: Subhankar is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Subhankar is a Sanskrit name composed of the words 'subha' meaning good fortune and 'ankar' meaning auspicious or prosperous. This name is believed to bring good fortune and prosperity to the bearer. The name Subhankar carries the meaning “Good fortune, auspicious, prosperous” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Bengali. Parents who choose Subhankar usually hope their child will grow to embody good fortune, auspicious, prosperous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Subhankar is a name that resonates with the energy of abundance and prosperity. It is a name that is believed to attract positive energy and bring good fortune in all areas of life.
data.etymology: Subhankar belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Good fortune, auspicious, prosperous.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Subhankar total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

In Hindu societies, people often give their children names that are believed to bestow good luck and prosperity. The name Subhankar reflects this cultural tradition and the desire for a promising future for the child.
data.spiritual_significance: In a spiritual context, the name Subhankar can be seen as a reminder of the blessings of the divine and the importance of living a life that is filled with good fortune and prosperity.
